ns.forside.023: How we workBuilt for AI from day one
ns.forside.025: We started with a blank sheet and built every workflow around AI agents and verified calculations, from the moment the basis arrives until the deliverable is signed. The agents read and write, the tools calculate, and the engineer spends the time on the assessments. That is why we can deliver faster and at a fixed price.
ns.forside.028: The whole basis, in every round. The agents are built for the discipline and the task, and show where in the basis each finding comes from.
ns.forside.031: The numbers come from verified calculations, never from the language model. The agent writes the text, and the numbers in it are checked against the calculations. The calculations give the same answer every time.
ns.forside.034: The responsible engineer checks the assumptions and interpretations, makes the assessments and is accountable for the deliverable.
ns.forside.038: AI reads the whole basis and pulls out what matters for the discipline. The engineer starts with the overview.
ns.forside.042: Verified calculation workflows. The same basis gives the same answer every time, and every number can be traced back.
ns.forside.044: Several programs, each for its own purpose
ns.forside.046: One toolset where the basis is entered once. The time goes to the assessments, not to building the same model in several places.
ns.forside.050: One flow from basis to deliverable. AI agents pick the tools the task needs, and the engineer is in control.
ns.forside.052: Notes written from a blank page in Word
ns.forside.054: The document is built from the basis and the calculations. The engineer checks every assessment before it goes out.
ns.forside.056: Hours of rework for every revision
ns.forside.058: When the basis changes, everything is recalculated and rechecked. The engineer sees what has changed and what it means.
ns.forside.060: Estimates in hours, and change notices afterwards
ns.forside.062: A fixed price for the deliverable. You know the cost before we start.
ns.forside.064: Licences for many programs, paid for through the hourly rate
ns.forside.066: Our own tools, built for the task. We do not pay for programs we do not need, and the price shows it.
ns.forside.067: UnchangedThe engineer in the discipline assesses, signs and is accountable.
ns.forside.068: NewYou pay for the deliverable. Not for the hours.
ns.forside.069: The technologyBuilt in the discipline
ns.forside.071: AI is not an IT project here. The engineers in the discipline, with solid AI expertise, build the agents and calculations they use themselves. That is why the tools fit the task, and we keep improving them.
ns.forside.072: Those who sign build the tools.The engineer who signs the deliverable has helped make the tools behind it.
ns.forside.073: Own agents per discipline.Each discipline gets its own agents and calculations, and new ones keep coming.
ns.forside.074: Discipline and AI in the same team.Decades of design and professional responsibility, and a research background in AI.
ns.forside.076: Independent control at a fixed price.
ns.forside.077: The control agent reads the whole design basis in every round, in all three disciplines. Each finding shows the document and page. The controller assesses the findings and signs.
ns.forside.079: Fixed price per discipline, excl. VAT · all control rounds included
ns.forside.081: The price covers up to three designer firms in the discipline.
ns.forside.084: Four products that follow the development project. Use one of them or all four. You can use the software without buying consulting, and the other way round.
